Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: ENGLISH

Topic 6.3: Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why should one use adverbs correctly? 2. Why should we use adverbs of frequency and degree correctly in communication?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 6.3.1 Word Classes: Adverbs together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication as learners use adverbs to speak effectively during conversations.

● Imagination and creativity as learners construct correct sentences using adverbs.

Values:
Respect: The learners help each other in constructing sentences correctly
